marketing_description: The DeWALT Cordless 5-Spot Green Line Laser offers a cordless design for convenience and features a magnetic mount for easy setup. This self-leveling laser has a working range of 330 ft with a detector and 280 ft without, and provides a cross-line laser projection with an accuracy of +/-1/8 in at 30 ft. It is part of the 20V MAX cordless platform and includes a 5-spot green line laser, ceiling/wall bracket, and laser target.
